title: enhance_prompt tool schema
description: Synchronous prompt-authoring utility for expanding or adapting a source prompt into an exact active image, video, or image-edit model's native prompt format.

prompt.description: The source prompt, rough idea, or prompt revision request to enhance.

target_output.description: The model-specific prompt artifact to produce. Use model_prompt only when destination_model unambiguously identifies the modality.

destination_model.description: Required exact active destination model selector, such as seedance2, ltx25, ltx23, wan22, minimax-h3-turbo, qwen, gpt-image-2, krea-2-turbo, chroma-v46-flash, or sdxl. Unknown and sunset models fail closed.

destination_tool.description: Optional downstream generation tool, such as generate_image, edit_image, generate_video, animate_photo, sound_to_video, or video_to_video.

prompting_type.description: Deprecated compatibility metadata. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.

model_title.description: Deprecated compatibility label. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.

style_prompt.description: Optional current style, brand, or prompt context to complement without repeating.

duration_seconds.description: Requested runtime when authoring a video prompt.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.

assets.description: Optional available assets the authored prompt may reference. The selected exact model contract applies its per-modality and total limits.

constraints.description: Optional production, brand, model, or user constraints to preserve.
